text.p: The following are the reports carrieds by Latvian newspapers on December 24. Reuters has not verified theses reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russian Ambassador Rannih said Latvia and Russia were just a few steps away from a radical improvement. He paid farewell visits to Latvian officials prior to his leaving the post.
- The government economy and fionance committee supported the proposed reduction to 21 lats from 25 the tax-exempted minimum of the employed.
- December's issue of the Euromoney ranks the Latvian Central bank presiden Einar Repshe, 34, among the world's 50 "financial leaders of the 21st century".
- Latvian pilots arrested in India for alleged arms smuggling are reported to have stopped their hunger strike, having been started demanding the announcement of the trial date.
